title: fix: clarify Pollinations contacts and legal operator
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Presents Pollinations.ai as the product and service name in the Terms.
- Explicitly identifies Myceli.AI OÜ as the legal service provider and contracting party, including the Estonian Commercial Register, registry code, VAT number, and registered address.
- Uses `hello@pollinations.ai` for general, privacy, and legal contact and `billing@pollinations.ai` for billing contact.
- Preserves all Myceli legal-entity, copyright, ownership, contributor, provider-account, infrastructure, and operational references.
- Documents the Pollinations brand/Myceli entity distinction and the feature branch → `main` → `production` flow; validated with `git diff --check`.

gist.headline: Names on the garden gate
gist.blurb: The legal pages now make the Pollinations.ai product name and its Myceli.AI OÜ operator a little less mysterious. General questions, privacy notes, and billing bees each have a clearer inbox too.
gist.summary: Updated the Terms and Privacy Policy to identify Pollinations.ai as the service, Myceli.AI OÜ as the Estonian legal provider and contracting party, and hello@pollinations.ai and billing@pollinations.ai as the relevant contact addresses.
gist.impact: Users can more easily see who operates the service, find the registered legal details, and reach the right Pollinations contact for general, privacy, legal, or billing questions.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden noticeboard represents clearer service identity and contact details: Polli, wearing a tiny postal-worker cap, pins two neatly labeled pixel letters onto a warm cream board marked “Pollinations.ai” and “Myceli.AI OÜ.” A small retro mailbox, flowering code-plants, and a subtle lime-green glow make the administrative task feel friendly rather than ominous.
